reference.summary: - Frontend: Next.js 14.2.15, React 18.3.1, TypeScript 5.7 - State Management: React Query (TanStack Query) - UI Components: Custom components + shadcn/ui patterns - Editor: CodeMirror 6 - Backend: FastAPI + PostgreSQL + asyncpg

Next.js 14 App Router with: - Server Components for data fetching - Client Components ('use client') for interactive UI - API routes in /api/v1/* proxied to FastAPI backend - Component structure: app/dashboard/{page}/page.tsx + components/{feature}/*.tsx

Story 4.1: Prompts Page - Rich Text Editor - Goal: Enhance existing prompts page with full editor capabilities - Fills gap from initial Next.js migration where prompts page was basic - Part of P1 (Should Have) priority epic - Prerequisites: None (enhances existing prompts page) - Technical Notes: Use CodeMirror or Monaco Editor, markdown preview with react-markdown, auto-save to localStorage

testing_strategy.coverage_requirements: - Unit test coverage: >= 80% - E2E tests: All critical user paths - Edge cases: Empty prompt, very long prompt (> 12000 chars), special characters in variables

constraint.description: Auto-save should debounce to avoid excessive localStorage writes
localStorage may not be available in private browsing or some browsers
constraint.solution: Wrap localStorage calls in try-catch, gracefully degrade if unavailable

constraint.description: Keyboard shortcuts must not conflict with browser/OS shortcuts
constraint.solution: Use Ctrl+S (standard save), avoid conflicts. Test on Windows/Mac/Linux

constraint.description: Draft recovery dialog should not be intrusive
constraint.solution: Use non-blocking toast notification, auto-dismiss after 10 seconds if no action

constraint.description: User should not lose work if auto-save fails
constraint.solution: Keep localStorage draft until successful server save confirmed

dev_notes.note: CodeMirrorEditor.tsx already has variable highlighting working. Build on this foundation rather than replacing it.
Use Context7 MCP to fetch latest CodeMirror 6 documentation when implementing new extensions (lineNumbers, search).
Consider using React.lazy() for MarkdownPreview to avoid loading react-markdown unless preview is toggled.
localStorage key format: "prompt_draft_{prompt_id}" or "prompt_draft_new" for new prompts.
Future enhancement (Story 4.2): Version history. Keep code extensible for that feature.
Existing components (SystemPromptEditor, VariableManager, TokenCounter) can be composed together in a new "EnhancedPromptEditor" wrapper component.
